pattern_1.transformation: Parse campaign collection date (%m/%d/%y) and convert from local Mountain Standard Time (Etc/GMT+7, UTC-7) to UTC ISO-8601. Discrete sampling campaign, not a sensor time series.

pattern_1.source_pattern: Top sample depth_cm, Bottom sample depth_cm
pattern_1.transformation: Depth reported as a range; approximate as the midpoint of top and bottom depth. Surface samples 2.5-7.5 cm -> 0.05 m (only these carry a water-content measurement). qc_flag d1 applies (depth approximated from a reported range).
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Average of top/bottom then divide by 100 to convert from cm to m.

pattern_1.transformation: Direct column mapping. Measured on surface (2.5-7.5 cm) samples only; subsurface (50-55 cm) rows have no water-content value and are dropped. A few erroneous negative %vol values present in the source are retained as computed.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 100 to convert from % to m³ m⁻³.

pattern_1.transformation: Sequential replicate number assigned within each site_id + depth_m + collection date group. Surface samples are single (replicate 1).
